tool.name: Deacon
tool.description: Data manager to download or build a Deacon database
tool.command: echo "Running in test mode: $test" && mkdir -p '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #if str($test) != "true" #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" #if str($input.download) == "human" zenodo_get 17288185 -m -g "*.idx" -o '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #elif str($input.download) == "mouse" zenodo_get 17699167 -m -g "*.idx" -o '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #else echo "Invalid prebuilt index selection" 1>&2 && exit 1 && #end if #else deacon index build '$input.from_dm.fields.path' -o '$out_file.extra_files_path/${input.from_dm.fields.value}.idx' && #end if #else ## create the files the dmjson entries reference so the data manager move step finds them touch '$out_file.extra_files_path/panhuman-1.k31w15.idx' '$out_file.extra_files_path/panmouse-1.k31w15.idx' && #end if #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" cp '$dmjson' '$out_file' #else source_digest=\$(sha256sum '$input.from_dm.fields.path' | cut -d ' ' -f 1) && sed "s/__SOURCE_DIGEST__/\$source_digest/g" '$dmjson' > '$out_file' #end if

param.name: is_select
param.label: Choose how to add data to the DM
param.option: Build index file from FASTA files available in Galaxy all_fasta table

param.name: download
param.label: Select which prebuilt should be downloaded
param.help: See help section for more information

validator.message: No genomes are available to build an index from

tool.help: Download prebuilt index files for deacon or build an index from FASTA files available on the Galaxy server in the all_fasta data table.
